mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(`date`, '%Y-%m-%d') AS orderDate, COUNT(*) AS orderQuantity FROM fc_fish_order WHERE ground_id = #{groundId} AND del_flag = 0 AND status = 1 AND `date` >= CURDATE() AND `date` < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(`date`, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT ffb.id AS boatId, ffb.boat_number, ffb.`status`, ffb.capacity, ffb.remark, ffo.id AS orderId, DATE_FORMAT( ffo.`date`, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS orderDate, IF( ffo.id IS NULL, 0, 1 ) AS reserve FROM fc_fish_boat ffb LEFT JOIN fc_fish_order ffo ON ffo.boat_id = ffb.id AND ffo.del_flag = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT( ffo.`date`, '%Y-%m-%d' ) = #{orderDate} WHERE ffb.ground_id = #{groundId} AND ffb.del_flag = 0 AND ffb.status = '1'
SELECT id, ground_name, `date`, boat_number, `status` FROM fc_fish_order WHERE del_flag = 0 AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY `date` DESC

SELECT ffo.id, ffo.ground_name, ffo.`date`, ffo.boat_number, ffo.`status`, ffg.phone, ffg.address FROM fc_fish_order ffo LEFT JOIN fc_fish_ground ffg ON ffg.id = ffo.ground_id AND ffg.del_flag = 0 WHERE ffo.del_flag = 0 AND ffo.id = #{id}
